# gyro_server (Resource)

A Gyro cloud server. Creating one places an order that is paid from the account balance (confirm_order must be true). Pick the product with product_id, or with plan + region (see gyro_products and gyro_locations). Destroying it cancels the service (see delete_immediately); the machine and its data are wiped after the grace period.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pick a product by plan + region (see gyro_products / gyro_locations) ...
resource "gyro_server" "web" {
  plan          = "standart-2-4"
  region        = "eu-de-1"
  image         = "debian-12"
  hostname      = "web-1.example.com"
  ssh_key_ids   = [tonumber(gyro_ssh_key.laptop.id)]
  power_state   = "running"
  confirm_order = true # creating a server is a paid order from your account balance
}

# ... or by product id from the catalog, e.g. the first product in stock in Helsinki.
data "gyro_products" "helsinki" {
  region         = "eu-fi-1"
  available_only = true
}

resource "gyro_server" "db" {
  product_id    = data.gyro_products.helsinki.products[0].id
  image         = "ubuntu-24.04"
  confirm_order = true
}

output "web_ipv4" {
  value = gyro_server.web.ipv4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `confirm_order` (Boolean) Must be true: creating a server spends account balance.
- `image` (String) Image slug from gyro_images, e.g. debian-12, or `custom:<id>` (`gyro_server_template.image`, tr-ist-1: the server is installed from your own template). Changing it replaces the server.

### Optional

- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Renew automatically from the account's payment source.
- `cycle` (String) Billing cycle: monthly (default), quarterly, semiannually, annually. Ignored for prepaid products (billed hourly from the account balance, e.g. region tr-ist-1).
- `delete_immediately` (Boolean) destroy cancels at once (default; billing stops, server powered off and wiped after the grace period). false = file a cancellation request instead.
- `hostname` (String) Host name. Changes are applied in place (must be a FQDN when renaming).
- `location` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated: legacy location code, kept so existing configurations and state keep working. Use region.
- `plan` (String) Plan name from gyro_products, e.g. standart-2-4. Use together with region. Changing it replaces the server.
- `power_state` (String) Desired power state: running or stopped.
- `product_id` (Number) Product id from gyro_products. Alternative to plan + region.
- `region` (String) Region from gyro_locations, e.g. eu-de-1 or tr-ist-1 (Istanbul; images from gyro_images with region = "tr-ist-1"). Use together with plan. Changing it replaces the server.
- `server_type` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated: legacy product code, kept so existing configurations and state keep working. Use plan.
- `ssh_key_ids` (List of Number) gyro_ssh_key ids to install at creation. Global regions: max 1. tr-ist-1 (Istanbul): up to 10, installed for root at creation through cloud-init (API 2.14.0+).
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) cloud-init user data (max 32 KiB): #cloud-config or a #! script. Every region, tr-ist-1 included since API 2.14.0.

### Read-Only

- `cores` (Number)
- `currency` (String) Price currency.
- `disk_gb` (Number)
- `due_date` (String)
- `id` (String) Server id (service id in the client area).
- `ipv4` (String) Primary IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_network` (String) IPv6 /64 network.
- `memory_gb` (Number)
- `price` (Number) Recurring price per cycle (VAT excluded).
- `status` (String) Service status (active, suspended, ...).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by server id (the service id shown in the client area)
terraform import gyro_server.web 47466
```
